courses = {}

courses["CS170"] = "Prof. Mongan"
courses["CS174"] = "Prof. Tralie"
courses["CS274"] = "Prof. Schilling"

print("CS170 is taught by: {}".format(courses["CS170"]))

for key, value in courses.items():
    print("{} is taught by: {}".format(key, value))
